scenarios.createHint: You can create a scenario by importing elevation map data as a new scenario, or by choosing “Save as scenario” from the system menu while playing.
scenarios.deleteConfirm: Delete the scenario "{{title}}"? This cannot be undone.
scenarios.author: Author
scenarios.editConfirm: Edit this scenario's city? All open windows will close, and unsaved edits in the terrain editor will be lost.
scenarios.copyConfirm: Edit a copy of this scenario? Saving it as a scenario adds it to your creations. All open windows will close, and unsaved edits in the terrain editor will be lost.
scenarios.readOnlyHint: Community and DLC scenarios cannot be edited directly. Edit a copy and save it as your own scenario.
scenarios.importDetailHint: The area where players develop the city and build roads and buildings.
scenarios.importFormats: Use a grayscale PNG (8- or 16-bit; the top of the image is north, the darkest pixel is the lowest elevation and the brightest pixel the highest) or a .npy 2-D array of elevations in meters (the first row is the southern edge).
scenarios.importInvalid: Check the values. The distance per pixel must be greater than 0 and at most 1000, elevations and sea level must be between -10000 and 10000, and the highest elevation must be above the lowest.
scenarios.importTooLarge: The map would be larger than {{max}} km on a side. Use a smaller distance per pixel or a file with fewer pixels.
scenarios.importBackgroundHint: Drawn as the backdrop outside the map. Players cannot build roads or buildings here.
scenarios.importBackgroundFormats: Elevation of the distant land outside the city. Use a .npy file holding a 2-D array of elevations in meters (first row is the south edge). It is resampled to a 50 m grid and centered on the city. The sea level is shared with the detailed terrain.
scenarios.importBackgroundInvalid: The background distance per pixel must be greater than 0 and at most 1000.
scenarios.importBackgroundTooLarge: The background would be larger than {{max}} km on a side. Use a smaller distance per pixel or a file with fewer pixels.
scenarios.previewEmpty: Choose a file to see a preview here.
scenarios.terrainOpenFailed: Could not open the scenario terrain.
scenarios.terrainEncryptedHint: This scenario was made from a DLC city and is encrypted, so the terrain editor cannot open it. Use Edit city to edit resources and props.
scenarios.cityLanguage: Language of names in the city
scenarios.startSettingsHint: Items with the “Changeable” checkbox on can be changed when starting a game.
scenarios.englishRequired: English text is required. The title must have English, and any other item you fill in also needs English.

saveCompatibility.balanceConfirm: This city uses core v{{from}} rules. Core v{{to}} may change game balance. Back up the original and continue?
saveCompatibility.IPC_CONTRACT_MISMATCH: Unity and UI contracts differ, or Unity cannot connect to the core.
saveCompatibility.SAVE_VERSION_UNKNOWN: Cannot load a save with unknown version information.
saveCompatibility.SAVE_VERSION_NEWER: Saved with a newer core version.
saveCompatibility.SAVE_CORRUPT: The save is corrupt or required data is missing.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_UPLOAD_FAILED: Upload failed. Your local scenario is still saved.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_METADATA_REQUIRED: Enter an English title and the author.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_PACKAGE_INVALID: The image cannot be loaded. Choose an image of 10 MB or less.
saveCompatibility.NO_ACTIVE_SESSION: No city is available to save.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_PACK_NOT_OWNED: You do not own a required add-on pack.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_PACK_UNVERIFIED: Ownership of the add-on pack has not been verified yet. Connect to the internet and complete Steam authentication.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_SIGNATURE_INVALID: The official scenario signature could not be verified. The file may have been modified.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_ENCRYPTION_INVALID: The encrypted data cannot be decrypted or has been modified.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_ENCRYPTED: The terrain of a DLC-derived scenario cannot be edited in the terrain editor. Use Edit city to edit its resources and props.
saveCompatibility.SESSION_ACTIVE: This is unavailable while a game is running. Return to the top menu first.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_TOO_LARGE: The scenario is larger than the upload limit.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_READ_ONLY: Community and DLC scenarios cannot be modified. Edit a copy instead.
saveCompatibility.NOT_FOUND: The data was not found. It may have been deleted. Refresh the list.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_ENGLISH_REQUIRED: Enter the English text. The title requires English.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_OPTION_FIXED: Settings fixed by the scenario cannot be changed.
saveCompatibility.SCENARIO_OPTION_INVALID: A start setting has an invalid value.
saveCompatibility.HEIGHTMAP_INVALID: This elevation file cannot be imported. Check the format (grayscale PNG or .npy) and the values you entered.
